The other instruments have only 6 trials each and are still in early accumulation; pendulum_lab is the closest to completion and the most critical for the laboratory's primary timekeeping function.

Continue baseline establishment (day 5 of 10). resonator_lab has shown highest variability; more trials will stabilize the baseline mean estimate and allow detection of genuine drift. No anomalies detected in cross-checks or autocorrelations warrant investigation yet.

The level shift around day 12 is the largest anomaly in the dataset (z≈14.12), dwarfing all other signals. I need to establish whether this shift is stable post-day-12 or transient. If it regresses toward baseline ~1.669, the shift was transient and may reflect artifact or a temporary environmental perturbation. Post-day-12 stabilization is the precondition for any publishable claim. I will not advance to environmental investigation, temperature measurement, or colleague inquiry until I have confirmed the shift persists.

I need to continue the post-baseline data collection through day 20 as committed in my day-10 review.
